title: Sable and the Harvest
author: Orsen Lockridge
blurb: Gideon Joubert, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
